A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type bar and the game-text box) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ESB2P-L-lonerogue-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Lone Rogue (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the 2013 slip. The 2017 slip prints no title in the strip below the text box; only the “E” remains.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, each as cut from its sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
